events.title: Fun Animal Friday: Foxes
events.description: Meet foxes with JAB Canid Education and Conservation Center on Friday, September 25, from 10:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. The event will include a live presentation, meet & greet*, storytime, and a special craft! Pre-registration is not required. Free with Museum admission. Opportunities to meet the animals are limited, and timed tickets will be provided upon check-in. *Meet and greet is entirely contingent upon the animals’ well-being. We recommend arriving at the Museum early to maximize your chances of meeting the animals. A Hold Harmless form is required to be filled out for all guests who want to meet the animals.

events.title: Fall Camp
events.description: Fall Camp 2026 Are you a creative and curious problem solver? Spend the fall exploring with Children's Museum of Discovery! Each day of camp includes access to Museum exhibits, hands-on exploration with trained education staff, and an opportunity to make new friends. Illuminate the secrets of our world after dark at Fall Camp: Nature at Night! Grab your flashlights and get ready for an adventure as we explore the fascinating nocturnal plants and animals that thrive after sunset. Campers will discover how these creatures live and adapt through hands-on STREAM activities and crafts. Ages: 4 - 8 years old Hours: 9:00 a.m. - 2:30 p.m. Learn More
events.location: Children's Museum of Discovery, 320 North Broadway, Escondido, CA

events.title: Winter Camp
events.description: Winter Camp 2026 Are you a creative and curious problem solver? Spend the winter exploring with Children's Museum of Discovery! Each day of camp includes access to Museum exhibits, hands-on exploration with trained education staff, and an opportunity to make new friends. Campers will spend the week exploring the wonder of our changing seasons! Through hands-on activities and crafts, we will learn why our weather is so different throughout the year. Ages: 4 - 8 years old Hours: 9:00 a.m. - 2:30 p.m. Learn More
events.location: Children's Museum of Discovery, 320 North Broadway, Escondido, CA
